213:         def to_numpy(x):
214:             return x.detach().cpu().numpy()
215: 
216:         @staticmethod
217:         def tril(mat, k=0):
218:             return _torch.tril(mat, diagonal=k)
219: 
220:         @staticmethod
221:         def tril_indices(n, k=0, m=None):
222:             if m is None:
223:                 m = n
224:             x = _torch.tril_indices(row=n, col=m, offset=k)
225:             return x[0], x[1]
226: 
227:         @staticmethod
228:         def triu(mat, k=0):
229:             return _torch.triu(mat, diagonal=k)
230: 
231:         @staticmethod
232:         def triu_indices(n, k=0, m=None):
233:             if m is None:
234:                 m = n
235:             x = _torch.triu_indices(row=n, col=m, offset=k)
236:             return x[0], x[1]
237: 
238:     class PyTorchLinalg:
239:         def __init__(self):
240:             self.inv = _torch.linalg.inv
241:             self.norm = _torch.linalg.norm
242: 
243:     class PyTorchRandom:
244:         def __init__(self):
245:             self.rand = _torch.rand
246:             self.randint = _torch.randint
247:             self.randn = _torch.randn
248: 
249:         @staticmethod
250:         def normal(loc=0.0, scale=1.0, size=(1,)):
251:             if not hasattr(size, "__iter__"):
252:                 size = (size,)
253:             return _torch.normal(mean=loc, std=scale, size=size)
254: 
255:         @staticmethod
256:         def uniform(low=0.0, high=1.0, size=(1,), dtype=None):
257:             if not hasattr(size, "__iter__"):
258:                 size = (size,)
259:             if low >= high:
260:                 raise ValueError("Upper bound must be higher than lower bound")
261:             return (high - low) * _torch.rand(*size, dtype=dtype) + low
262: 
263:     class PyTorchTesting:
264:         def __init__(self):
265:             self.assert_allclose = _torch.allclose
266:             self.assert_equal = _torch.testing.assert_close
